(Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: Alibaba to Sell Gaming Arm for $1.5 Billion in Boost to AI Pivot

ai.title: LG AI Research's Lee on The Importance of Sovereign AI
ai.description: LG AI Research Head of Superintelligence Lab Lee Moon Tae shares his perspective on the future of superintelligence, the opportunities it unlocks and the responsibilities that come with building AI for the next era. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'AI Summit Seoul & Expo 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: AI Era Demands More Agile Leaders, Harvard’s Linda Hill Says
ai.description: The next generation of chief executives will need to spend more time building flexible organizations as the deployment of artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes how companies do business, according to Harvard Business School Professor Linda Hill.

ev_autonomous.description: Tesla has discontinued the Solar Roof, its solar-tile roofing product, Electrek has learned. The company has told third-party installers that it will no longer supply solar roof tiles going forward, only solar panels, according to two sources close to the program.

ev_autonomous.title: Tesla’s Cybercab is about to launch — and we don’t get it
ev_autonomous.description: Tesla has told employees it is preparing a public launch of the Cybercab in Austin as soon as this month, according to a report from The Information. It would be the first Tesla vehicle ever built without a steering wheel or pedals — and the least exciting vehicle the company has ever made, because it is virtually worthless without an autonomous driving system Tesla still hasn’t delivered at scale.

business.title: Pony AI CEO Peng Optimistic on Growth Outlook
business.description: James Peng, CEO of Pony AI, says the company plans to expand its robotaxi fleet across more Chinese cities to meet growing demand. He speaks to David Ingles and Yvonne Man on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

business.title: Xiaomi Earnings Key to Extending Stock’s Best Rally In a Year

business.description: Alphabet Inc. is poised to pay just under 7% to borrow longer-dated funds in its debut Australian dollar bond deal, in potentially its highest-ever coupon, underscoring how broader demands for cash among hyperscalers around the world are feeding into more costly funding almost everywhere.

business.title: Rebellions CFO: Preparing for IPO in Korea
business.description: Sungkyue Shin, CFO of AI chip startup Rebellions, says the company is in active preparations for an IPO, with a listing on South Korea's main stock exchange as its top priority. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen from the sidelines of the AI Summit & Expo in Seoul. (Source: Bloomberg)

business.title: Unitree Shares Jump After $904M Shanghai IPO | The China Show | 8/19/2026
business.description: “Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

business.title: AI Startup Temporal in Talks for a Valuation of at Least $12 Billion
business.description: Temporal Technologies Inc. is in talks for a fresh funding round that would give the AI startup a valuation of at least $12 billion before the new money, according to people familiar with the efforts.

regulation.description: Apple yesterday updated its App Store fees in the EU to comply with the Digital Markets Act and to put an end to its ongoing conflict with the European Commission. Apple cut the Core Technology Fee and simplified its pricing structure, so apps distributed through alternative marketplaces or through the web will pay less than before. robotics.description: China’s humanoid robot makers now control 97% of global shipments, giving Beijing an early lead over U.S. rivals. robotics.title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600%, outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets
robotics.description: A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price.

robotics.title: China's Xynova on Developing Human-like Robot Hands
robotics.description: Alex Xia, Founder and CEO at Hangzhou-based robot hand maker Xynova, discusses innovation and industry bottlenecks. He also talks about and fundraising plans exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

other.description: China is pulling the plug on an older version of Microsoft Corp.’s Windows tailored for government agencies, taking another step toward rooting out the world’s most popular PC software in a broader effort to reduce its dependence on foreign technology.

other.description: The UK government is facing calls to cancel a sprawling health care contract with Palantir. The region of Greater Manchester insists it can do a better job itself.
